artifact_decision.analysis_source: The exact SHA-256-pinned Project Gutenberg UTF-8 electronic file, not a reconstructed or imputed print edition.
artifact_decision.permitted_claim: Version-conditioned lexical and MWE analysis after deterministic non-body removal and unit admission.
forbidden_claims: diplomatic representation of a named print edition
historical orthography evidence without comparison to page images
worldwide permission to bundle or serve source prose
representativeness of contemporary L2 or examination reading

review_policy.reviewed_material: Title, copyright, dedication, contents, illustration, and explicit transcriber-note matter needed to locate the first prose unit and document the electronic artifact.
review_policy.excluded_from_units: Project Gutenberg notices, title/copyright matter, dedications, contents, illustration lists and captions, advertisements, and transcriber notes.
review_policy.front_matter_hash_rule: SHA-256 over the exact raw bytes of the inclusive one-based line range, preserving source line endings.
review_policy.textual_contributor_rule: A translator, adapter, editor, introducer, or other retained textual contributor must be named and rights-reviewed; purely visual contributors do not enter prose units.
